argv: run-as com.cooper.lithic.m22verify.debug sh -c 'printf '"'"'M22_DEFAULT_METADATA_BEGIN\n'"'"'; id -u; readlink -f no_backup; for p in no_backup/active-generation no_backup/androidx.work.workdb no_backup/androidx.work.workdb-wal no_backup/androidx.work.workdb-shm; do if [ -e "$p" ] || [ -L "$p" ]; then stat -c '"'"'META=%n|%u|%g|%i|%s|%Y|%f'"'"' "$p"; fi; done; for d in no_backup/generations/*; do if [ -d "$d" ]; then stat -c '"'"'DIR=%n|%u|%g|%i|%s|%Y|%f'"'"' "$d"; for n in data.db data.db-wal data.db-shm settings.preferences_pb ready.json; do p="$d/$n"; if [ -e "$p" ]; then stat -c '"'"'META=%n|%u|%g|%i|%s|%Y|%f'"'"' "$p"; fi; done; fi; done; printf '"'"'M22_DEFAULT_METADATA_END\n'"'"''
privacy: Exact USB serial retained only in ignored control. Filtered full output processed in memory; raw bytes/SHA refer to complete command output.
